**Saudi Arabia's Interior Ministry arrested [8,090 violators](https://timesofoman.com//article/172387-omans-maritime-security-centre-detects-suspected-floating-mine-in-strait-of-hormuz) of residency, work, and border security regulations in a week**, per the Saudi Press Agency. The crackdown reflects the kingdom's continued enforcement of labor and immigration laws following the successful Hajj season, which saw 2 million pilgrims complete the pilgrimage.

Oman's Maritime Security Centre detected a [suspected floating mine](https://timesofoman.com//article/172387-omans-maritime-security-centre-detects-suspected-floating-mine-in-strait-of-hormuz) in the Strait of Hormuz, according to the Times of Oman, though authorities have not specified the mine's origin or posed threat level to shipping. The discovery comes as regional tensions over maritime security remain elevated.
